questions.title: Diagnosis
questions.text: What are the most important factors currently undermining long-term human and planetary well-being, and why?

questions.title: Causality & Responsibility
questions.text: If humanity has long been aware of these challenges, why have they not been meaningfully addressed?

questions.title: Solutions (Living Well Enough)
questions.text: What kinds of changes would be required for humanity to achieve long-term collective well-being — living well enough for all within planetary limits?
